mapper.select: SELECT gs.id, gs.script_id, s.name as script_name, gs.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, gs.session_time, gs.player_names, gs.status, gs.created_at, CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as has_reviewed, #{playerName} as current_player FROM group_sessions gs JOIN scripts s ON gs.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON gs.dm_id = d.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON gs.id = r.group_session_id AND r.player_name = #{playerName} ORDER BY gs.session_time DESC

SELECT gs.id, gs.script_id, s.name as script_name, gs.dm_id, d.name as dm_name, gs.session_time, gs.player_names, gs.status, gs.created_at, CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as has_reviewed, NULL as current_player FROM group_sessions gs JOIN scripts s ON gs.script_id = s.id JOIN dms d ON gs.dm_id = d.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON gs.id = r.group_session_id WHERE gs.id = #{id}
